title: The Fallen Messenger
text: Something with wings lies broken in a smoking crater, glowing faintly, feathers scattered like snow. Its eyes are full of light. It is trying to say a word, a single word, over and over, and it cannot finish it before its breath gives out.

options.label: The best healer tends its broken wings.

outcomes.text: It breathes, and finishes the word at last, and the word is a blessing, and it settles on them like light.

options.label: The wisest finishes the word for it.

outcomes.text: A name, and a warning about the End Ruler, and then its light goes out.

options.label: Take its feathers while it dies.

outcomes.text: Each one is worth a fortune. It watches you take them, and its eyes never close.
